    "Securely stores and generates strong passwords",

    "Supports OTP codes and various item types like notes"

  "cons": [
    "Limitations on users and collections for free organizations",
    "Admin console for sharing is separate from personal vault",
    "Browser extension may occasionally require relogging or locking"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This educator likely found Bitwarden to be a highly valuable and secure solution for managing passwords and OTP codes, especially given its affordability for a small team. While the core functionality of storing and sharing passwords was effective, the separation of the personal vault and organizational admin console, along with limitations on user count for free organizations, might have introduced some minor friction in team management."
